_comment: MCP servers for this project. Run `claude mcp add` or edit this file, then restart Claude Code. Playwright is for visual/e2e testing the cinematic UI. Postgres is a read-only peek into local dev data — never point it at prod.

playwright.description: Browser automation for iterating on the cinematic UI. Use to drive the admin review-creation flow end-to-end while building.

postgres.description: Read-only peek into the local dev DB. Handy for 'show me the current watch list order' without writing scripts. NEVER change this URL to a prod connection string.
